name: Juice & Smoothie Bar (Standalone)
description: Dedicated quick-service juice and smoothie concept focused entirely on freshly extracted cold-pressed juices, nutrient-rich smoothies, functional wellness shots, handcrafted superfood bowls, advance cleanse detox programs, and wholesome energy snacks. Optimized for fitness centers, shopping concourses, lifestyle pavilions, and urban wellness hubs without a traditional cafe coffee setup.

sections.name: Fresh Juices
sections.description: Features 100% pure cold-pressed and made-to-order fruit and vegetable juices pressed without added water, sugars, or preservatives. Represents the primary beverage identity for health-conscious customers seeking immediate raw vitamins, living enzymes, and optimal hydration.

subSections.name: Single Fruit Juices
subSections.description: Pure unblended freshly pressed single-origin juices celebrating whole fruits like crisp green apple, sweet valencia orange, ruby red grapefruit, and chilled watermelon.

subSections.name: Mixed & Combination Juices
subSections.description: Harmonious signature blends pairing complementary fruits, citrus, and sweet roots such as apple-carrot-ginger, orange-passionfruit-mint, and pineapple-cucumber.

subSections.name: Vegetable & Green Juices
subSections.description: Alkalizing, nutrient-dense green elixirs pressed with dark leafy kale, baby spinach, celery stalks, crisp cucumber, parsley, and Meyer lemon.

sections.name: Smoothies & Blends
sections.description: Covers rich, thick, fiber-dense blended beverages prepared fresh to order with whole frozen fruits, nutrient supergreens, customizable plant milks, and performance enhancers. Serves as wholesome meal replacements, post-workout muscle recovery drinks, and energizing guilt-free treats.

subSections.name: Fruit Smoothies
subSections.description: Thick, creamy blends of whole frozen fruits such as wild blueberries, ripe bananas, mango chunks, strawberries, and tropical pineapples.

subSections.name: Green & Detox Smoothies
subSections.description: Clean, alkalizing blends combining crisp greens, organic baby spinach, curly kale, avocado, green apples, and fresh garden mint.

subSections.name: Protein & Energy Smoothies
subSections.description: High-protein blends formulated with whey or organic plant proteins, natural nut butters, rolled oats, and sustained-energy superfoods.

sections.name: Health & Wellness Shots
sections.description: Offers concentrated, cold-pressed 2 oz wellness elixirs formulated for immediate functional impact, immune defense, natural detoxification, and metabolic stimulation. Designed for quick counter consumption or as a powerful nutritional companion to any beverage.

subSections.name: Immunity Shots
subSections.description: Potent immune-strengthening elixirs formulated with ginger root, raw turmeric, echinacea, fresh lemon juice, and black pepper.

subSections.name: Detox Shots
subSections.description: Purifying shots featuring organic wheatgrass, activated coconut charcoal, organic apple cider vinegar, and milk thistle.

subSections.name: Energy Shots
subSections.description: Revitalizing botanical boosters powered by Japanese matcha, guarana, beet root concentrate, and cayenne pepper.

sections.name: Smoothie & Açaí Bowls
sections.description: Features thick, chilled superfood bowls anchored by frozen organic Amazonian açaí, vibrant pitaya, blended smoothie greens, or warm oatmeal. Artfully arranged with sliced fruits, crunchy gluten-free granolas, seeds, and drizzles to serve as nutritious breakfast and lunch meals.

subSections.name: Açaí Bowls
subSections.description: Traditional thick-blended wild Amazonian açaí berry purée topped with fresh sliced fruit, artisanal granola, and superfoods.

subSections.name: Pitaya Bowls
subSections.description: Vibrant dragon fruit smoothie bowls blended with tropical fruits and finished with crisp seeds and fresh coconut.

subSections.name: Smoothie Bowls
subSections.description: Extra-thick whole fruit and green spirulina blends spooned into bowls with customizable colorful superfood toppings.

subSections.name: Oatmeal Bowls
subSections.description: Warm steel-cut oats and chilled overnight chia puddings layered with cinnamon, sliced banana, and pure maple syrup.

sections.name: Light Bites & Snacks
sections.description: Wholesome, solid food snacks crafted from clean whole ingredients that complement beverage purchases. Designed for rapid grab-and-go counter service without commercial fryers or heavy cooktops, providing portable nourishment for gym-goers, commuters, and busy shoppers.

subSections.name: Energy Bars & Bites
subSections.description: House-crafted raw protein balls, date-and-nut energy bites, seed flapjacks, and gluten-free snack bars.

subSections.name: Fresh Fruit Cups
subSections.description: Chilled hand-cut seasonal fruit medleys, pineapple spears, watermelon cubes, and fresh berry cups.

subSections.name: Wraps & Toast
subSections.description: Fresh artisan toasts such as smashed avocado sourdough or almond butter banana, alongside light plant-rich tortilla wraps.

sections.name: Cleanse & Detox Packages
sections.description: Comprehensive multi-bottle cold-pressed juice programs designed for structured digestive rest, metabolic resets, and cellular revitalization. Prepared in numbered daily bottles with scheduled advance booking to ensure maximum living nutrient retention.

subSections.name: 1-Day Cleanse
subSections.description: Single-day gentle reboot featuring 6 cold-pressed juices and 1 wellness immunity shot with guided intake schedule.

subSections.name: 3-Day Cleanse
subSections.description: Our most requested 3-day deep reset consisting of 18 cold-pressed juices, 3 wellness shots, and complete cleanse guide.

subSections.name: 5-Day Cleanse
subSections.description: Intensive 5-day total body reset package including 30 cold-pressed juices, 5 wellness booster shots, and herbal detox tea.

subSections.name: Custom Programs
subSections.description: Personalized juice regimens tailored to individual fitness milestones, athletic training, or low-sugar dietary preferences.

choices.label: Level 1: Refresh & Reboot (Fruit, Roots & Mild Greens)
Level 2: Core Cleanse (Balanced Greens, Citrus & Nut Milk)
Level 3: Deep Green Detox (High-Alkaline Pure Greens)

timeBehavior.note: Requires 24-hour advance pre-order notice for freshly cold-pressed batch bottling

sections.name: Add-Ons & Boosters
sections.description: Cross-section modular enhancer catalog allowing patrons to fortify any juice, smoothie, or bowl with targeted plant proteins, functional superfoods, omega-rich seeds, and adaptogenic wellness extracts.

subSections.name: Proteins
subSections.description: Grass-fed whey isolate, certified organic vegan pea/rice protein powders, and hydrolysed marine collagen peptides.

subSections.name: Superfoods
subSections.description: Concentrated superfood powders including organic blue spirulina, ceremonial matcha, wheatgrass, and Peruvian maca root.

subSections.name: Seeds & Nuts
subSections.description: Nutrient-dense raw seeds and nuts including black chia, shelled hemp hearts, flaxseed meal, and raw cacao nibs.

subSections.name: Functional Boosts
subSections.description: Targeted active boosters including ashwagandha adaptogen, organic coconut MCT oil, cold-pressed ginger, and raw local honey.

sections.name: Seasonal & Limited
sections.description: Showcases rotating seasonal harvest specials, limited-batch holiday beverages, and exclusive functional collaborations. Celebrates peak farm harvests and seasonal cravings—from summer watermelon refreshers to autumn spiced warm apple elixirs.

subSections.name: Seasonal Fruit Specials
subSections.description: Chilled limited-edition juices and smoothies highlighting peak-season crops such as summer watermelon, passionfruit, and stone fruits.

subSections.name: Holiday & Limited Editions
subSections.description: Festive specialty creations including spiced harvest ciders, pumpkin protein smoothies, and winter citrus antioxidant refreshers.

subSections.name: Wellness Collaborations
subSections.description: Limited-run wellness recipes developed in collaboration with local fitness instructors, athletic clubs, and organic farms.

systemFeatures.name: Add-On Boosters & Superfoods
systemFeatures.description: Enables customers to enhance juices, smoothies, and bowls with nutritional boosters like protein powder, chia seeds, collagen, and spirulina.

systemFeatures.name: Sweetness Level Customization
systemFeatures.description: Allows guests to customize sweetness percentage or natural sweetener quantity for fresh juices, smoothies, and seasonal drinks.

systemFeatures.name: Ice Level Customization
systemFeatures.description: Allows guests to customize ice volume for fresh juices, cold blended smoothies, and seasonal specialties.

systemFeatures.name: Cleanse Package Pre-Orders
systemFeatures.description: Enables advance ordering and scheduled pickup dates for multi-day detox cleanse packages requiring advance batch pressing and bottling.

systemFeatures.name: Allergen & Dietary Indicators
systemFeatures.description: Displays allergen alerts (tree nuts, peanuts, dairy, soy, gluten) and dietary lifestyle tags (vegan, vegetarian, organic, raw, keto, sugar-free) across all juice and food items.

systemFeatures.name: Live Stock & Availability Badges
systemFeatures.description: Displays dynamic inventory tags including Sold Out Today, Limited Edition, Made to Order, Seasonal, and Low Stock warnings for fresh produce and cleanses.
